title: Petrol Langar in Chandigarh Trending in India
description: Reports indicate a 'Petrol Langar' is being organized in Chandigarh by Raja D King, featuring fuel distribution and coupons.

sections.heading: Petrol Langar Event
paragraphs: According to Amar Ujala, a 'Petrol Langar' is taking place in Chandigarh today. Navbharat Times reports that this event follows a previous distribution of money.

sections.heading: Organizer and Funding Source
paragraphs: The event is being organized by an individual named Raja D King, according to Amar Ujala and Jagran. Amar Ujala states that the fuel being distributed is funded by Bitcoin profits.

sections.heading: Distribution Items
paragraphs: Navbharat Times states that Raja D King will give people coupons worth 500 to 1000 rupees. Additionally, Jagran reports that free iPhones will also be distributed.

sections.heading: Location and Timing
paragraphs: The event is set to occur in Chandigarh. Navbharat Times mentions that people should note the specific place and timing. Jagran also advises noting the date for the event.
